features.quote: Optimizing for 'reproduction rate' will overfit the eval to the spiral... you converge on tasks engineered to be maximally demoralizing rather than representative
features.justification_quote: The number you get won't track real-world incidence, and regression-testing against it will reward models that are robust to your specific trap, not models that are robust generally.
